title: Concatenating run intervals
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine, $c$ a configuration on a fixed input, $T_1,T_2$ natural numbers, and $Q$ a property of configurations. If $Q$ holds for every configuration reached from $c$ by at most $T_1$ steps, and also for every configuration reached from the configuration at time $T_1$ by at most $T_2$ further steps, then $Q$ holds for every configuration reached from $c$ by at most $T_1+T_2$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $Q$ holds along the run from $c$ at every time at most $T_1$
$Q$ holds along the run from the time-$T_1$ configuration at every further time at most $T_2$
